clusters.label: Positive Hall coefficient
clusters.definition: A Hall coefficient with positive sign.
clusters.reason: Both explicitly report the same signed transport quantity; material identities remain claim-specific.

clusters.label: Thermoelectric materials
clusters.definition: The application class of materials for thermoelectric use.
clusters.reason: All denote the same explicit application class, while the proposed candidate compositions and supporting properties differ.

clusters.label: Narrowed bandwidth
clusters.definition: Reduction of electronic bandwidth associated with Co–O–Co bond bending in layered cobaltites.
clusters.reason: Both describe bandwidth narrowing accompanying decreased tolerance factor and increased CoO6 distortion, with reduced eg-electron mobility.

clusters.label: Increased Co–O–Co bond bending
clusters.definition: An increase in bending of Co–O–Co bonds.
clusters.reason: Both identify the same structural change associated with enhanced CoO6 distortion as A-site rare-earth ionic radius decreases.

clusters.label: Tolerance factor t
clusters.definition: The perovskite structural tolerance descriptor denoted t.
clusters.reason: All explicitly identify the same perovskite descriptor. Its use in transport interpretation or as a model feature does not change the quantity.

clusters.label: Oxygen content
clusters.definition: The amount of oxygen present in a material's composition.
clusters.reason: Both denote compositional oxygen content; its determination in superconductors and its influence in manganites are separate claims about the same quantity.

clusters.label: Mixed ionic and covalent bonding
clusters.definition: Bonding with both ionic and covalent contributions.
clusters.reason: All explicitly describe mixed ionic and covalent bonding without specifying different bonding subtypes in these concept labels.

clusters.label: Ba2HfS4
clusters.definition: The layer-structured compound with composition Ba2HfS4.
clusters.reason: Explicit Hf composition distinguishes it from Ba2ZrS4.

clusters.label: Ba2ZrS4
clusters.definition: The layer-structured compound with composition Ba2ZrS4.
clusters.reason: Explicit Zr composition distinguishes it from Ba2HfS4; parenthetical property reporting does not establish material equivalence.

clusters.label: Machinability
clusters.definition: A material's suitability for machining.
clusters.reason: Both refer to machinability itself. Pressure-induced increase is expressed by the second relation, rather than defining a separate quantity.

clusters.label: Small-polaron hopping
clusters.definition: Transport through hopping of small polarons.
clusters.reason: Each explicitly names the same transport mechanism; dopants, materials and temperature regimes remain attached to their claims.

clusters.label: GaGe2Te
clusters.definition: The layered compound with composition GaGe2Te.
clusters.reason: Both identify layered GaGe2Te with no conflicting composition or sample qualifier. Calculated transport and structural characterization concern the same material concept.

clusters.label: Ionic-covalent bonding
clusters.definition: Bonding exhibiting ionic and covalent character.
clusters.reason: Both explicitly identify the same bonding character; the different host compounds do not redefine this interaction concept.

clusters.label: Dopant ionic radius
clusters.definition: The ionic radius of a dopant ion.
clusters.reason: Both denote the same dopant property. Electron-cloaking selection and site-dependent band-curvature trends are distinct uses of that property.

clusters.label: Thermal insulation materials
clusters.definition: The application class of materials used for thermal insulation.
clusters.reason: Both labels explicitly denote the same application class, without identifying their different candidate materials as equivalent.

clusters.label: Poisson's ratio
clusters.definition: The elastic ratio relating transverse and longitudinal strain.
clusters.reason: All use the same elastic quantity to interpret bonding; different bonding conclusions and material conditions remain claim-specific.

clusters.label: Tetradymite-type structure
clusters.definition: The tetradymite structural type attributed to the reported crystalline chalcogenide nanoparticles.
clusters.reason: Both explicitly denote a shared structural type, rather than the distinct Bi–Te, Bi–Sb–Te and Bi–Se compositions.

clusters.label: Fermi-level unpinning
clusters.definition: Release of the Fermi level from a pinned state.
clusters.reason: Both explicitly identify unpinning. Ionic Pb–Se bond formation and excess Sn addition are distinct inducing mechanisms, while conduction-band shifting is separately stated.

clusters.label: Ti2MnB
clusters.definition: The full-Heusler compound with composition Ti2MnB.
clusters.reason: Its explicit Ti composition distinguishes it from Zr2MnB.

clusters.label: Zr2MnB
clusters.definition: The full-Heusler compound with composition Zr2MnB.
clusters.reason: Its explicit Zr composition distinguishes it from Ti2MnB; jointly reported Seebeck results do not imply equivalence.

clusters.label: Higher refractive indices
clusters.definition: Refractive indices greater than those of the stated comparison materials.
clusters.reason: Both denote the same direction of comparative optical property. Comparison materials, spectral context and proposed causes remain specific to each claim.

clusters.label: Greater stiffness
clusters.definition: Greater resistance to elastic deformation relative to a stated comparator.
clusters.reason: All express greater mechanical stiffness; the different compounds and phase comparisons remain attached to their original claims.
